description.value: Ucluelet Brewing Company is a craft brewery and tasting room housed inside the beautifully restored historic St. Aidan's on the Hill church on Peninsula Road in Ucluelet. The brewery produces a full lineup of house-crafted beers — from easy-drinking lagers and kölsch to hazy IPAs and an oatmeal coffee stout — served alongside a food menu in a cozy, community-oriented atmosphere. It is a genuine gathering place for locals and a natural stop for cyclists exploring Vancouver Island's wild west coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Ucluelet Brewing Company is a real, operating craft brewery and tasting room at 1601 Peninsula Road, Ucluelet BC, with phone (250) 726-0499 — both pieces of contact info are absent from the OSM record but clearly stated on the website. The brewery occupies a renovated historic church and serves a full lineup of house-crafted beers alongside a food menu, with active job postings and social media presence confirming it is open. No bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, e-bike charging, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website, leaving those fields null.
concerns: OSM record has no phone or address; both have been populated from the website.
Front page and contact page show differing schedules, suggesting one section of the website may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating craft brewery and restaurant with a confirmed address, phone, and active website. A clear stop for touring cyclists on the west coast of Vancouver Island.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website states no pets permitted inside or on the patio, and the tasting room does not accept reservations.
